Establishes: Single-stage HPT blade tip with pressure/suction-side squealer ribs 52/54 bifurcated by a chordal tip baffle 58 into an aft-open first pocket 60 and a closed second pocket 62; exemplary ribs about 25 mils (0.6 mm) wide and 56 mils (1.4 mm) high; describes reducing the single-stage HPT row from eighty parent blades to seventy-six.
